description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Intimidation Campaign by paying {3}.
When Intimidation Campaign enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life, and you to gain 1 life and draw a card.
Queza triggers, targeting an opponent.
When you commit that crime, Intimidation Campaign's second ability triggers, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Queza trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
If you have less than {3} available, activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
If Chromatic Orrery is untapped, activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Repeat from step 2.
